invariants.rationale: The dedupedRecords parameter is used and passed to HoodieListData.eager, so it must not be null.
context is passed to tagLocation and must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
table is dereferenced to call getIndex, so it must not be null.
table.getIndex() is called and its tagLocation method is used, so the result must not be null.
Typically, tagging makes sense only for non-empty input; empty input may be a trivial or special case.
